title: אריה פראי
summary: הסטרימר הופך לאיש-אריה זועם עם עיניים זוהרות, רעמה שחורה וטפרים ששולח יד אל המצלמה.

phases.what: Normal streamer sitting in chair looking at camera
Extreme close-up on eye turning glowing amber, pulling back to show dark veins and small fangs
Medium shot with dark veins spreading and fiery embers floating
Head morphs into a roaring lion with dark mane, shirt tears
Arms become furry lion limbs with sharp claws resting on desk
Lion beast lunges forward, swiping a giant clawed paw directly at the camera

remix.prompt: The person in the image is live-streaming at home and suddenly transforms into a ferocious werelion in one continuous 9-second shot. Keep the person recognizable until the full lion head transformation covers the face. First, zoom rapidly into their eye as the iris turns glowing fiery amber with a vertical slit pupil, then pull back to reveal dark cracked veins spreading across their skin and small fangs appearing alongside floating orange embers. Next, their head violently morphs into a roaring lion with a thick dark brown and black mane, tearing their black shirt as their torso bulks up and arms sprout golden-brown fur and giant sharp claws. Finally, the lion beast lunges forward over the desk, swiping a massive clawed paw directly at the lens. Dramatic dark cinematic lighting with warm amber eye glow and cool blue background accents, vertical framing.
